description: This file contains a PHP class named Cloud that extends the System Engine Model. It manages a database table 'product_bestseller' with methods for installing (creating table), uninstalling (dropping table), editing total sales, deleting entries, and reporting functions.

classes.name: Cloud
classes.description: A model class for managing product bestseller data, including install, uninstall, update, delete, and report retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'product_bestseller' table in the database if it does not exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'product_bestseller' table from the database if it exists.

methods.name: editTotal
methods.description: Replaces or inserts a record in the 'product_bestseller' table with the given product ID and total.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a record from the 'product_bestseller' table based on product ID.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products sorted by total sales in descending order, with optional pagination.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total count of entries in the 'product_bestseller' table.
